答案:
第一題
📌 參考答案
A 松
A Pine
📌 詳細解釋
松樹以種子繁殖，而種子是包含在毬果中。
Pine reproduces by seeds contained in cones.
蕨類是以孢子繁殖的。
Fern reproduces by spores.
草和蠶豆是開花植物，並由種子繁殖。
Grass and broad bean are flowering plants and reproduce by seeds.
📌 考試提醒
裸子植物的種子裸露於毬果中，沒有果實包被。
The seeds of gymnosperms are naked in cones and not enclosed by fruits.
常見錯誤：誤以為所有產生種子的植物都會開花。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that all seed-producing plants bear flowers.

第二題
📌 參考答案
C (3)、(1)、(2)、(4)
C (3), (1), (2), (4)
📌 詳細解釋
圖(3)顯示染色質凝縮成染色體。
Figure (3) shows the chromatin condenses to form chromosomes.
圖(1)顯示每條染色體含有兩個染色單體。
Figure (1) shows each chromosome consisting of two chromatids.
圖(2)顯示染色體排列於赤道板。
Figure (2) shows the chromosomes line up in the middle.
圖(4)顯示每一染色體的兩組染色單體分開。
Figure (4) shows the two chromatids of each chromosome separate.
📌 考試提醒
染色體複製發生於間期，此時染色體處於染色質狀態，在顯微鏡下無法看見。
Chromosome replication occurs during interphase, when chromosomes are in the form of chromatin and invisible under a microscope.
常見錯誤：誤以為圖(1)代表染色體正在進行複製。
Common trap：Mistakenly assuming that figure (1) represents chromosomes undergoing replication.

第三題
📌 參考答案
D 兩者都沒有葉綠體。
D Both are absent of chloroplasts.
📌 詳細解釋
人的紅血球沒有細胞核、細胞壁、中央液泡及葉綠體。
Red blood cells lack a nucleus, cell wall, central vacuole, and chloroplasts.
洋蔥表皮細胞有細胞核、細胞壁和中央液泡，但沒有葉綠體。
Onion epidermal cells have a nucleus, cell wall, and central vacuole, but do not have chloroplasts.
📌 考試提醒
只有暴露於光線下的植物綠色部分才會發育出葉綠體。
Only the green parts of plants exposed to light will develop chloroplasts.
常見錯誤：死記所有植物細胞都含有葉綠體，忽略了洋蔥表皮生長在地下。
Common trap：Rote learning that all plant cells contain chloroplasts, ignoring that onion epidermis grows underground.

第四題
📌 參考答案
A 藍色、棕色、紅色沉澱
A Blue, brown, red precipitate
📌 詳細解釋
透析管內的澱粉被澱粉酶分解，形成麥芽糖。
The starch in the dialysis tubing is broken down by the amylase to form maltose.
麥芽糖的分子足夠小，可以擴散出透析管，因此本立德試驗產生紅色沉澱。
Maltose is small enough to diffuse out of the tubing, so Benedict's test gives a red precipitate.
蛋白質和澱粉分子太大，不能穿過透析管，故二縮脲試驗呈藍色及碘液試驗呈棕色。
Proteins and starch are too large to pass through the dialysis tubing, hence the biuret test is blue and the iodine test is brown.
📌 考試提醒
差異透性膜只容許小分子（如葡萄糖、麥芽糖）穿過，大分子（如澱粉、蛋白質）則不能。
A differentially permeable membrane only allows small molecules (like glucose and maltose) to pass through, but not large molecules (like starch and proteins).
常見錯誤：忘記酶本身就是一種蛋白質，誤以為會擴散出來而令二縮脲試驗呈陽性。
Common trap：Forgetting that enzymes are themselves proteins, and mistakenly assuming they will diffuse out and cause a positive biuret test.

第五題
📌 參考答案
D 用蒸餾水沖洗透析管表面，然後才放入大試管內。
D Rinse the outside of the dialysis tubing with distilled water before placing it in the boiling tube.
📌 詳細解釋
清洗透析管表面能保證大試管中的蒸餾水不會受到澱粉污染。
Rinsing the outside of the dialysis tubing ensures that the distilled water in the boiling tube will not be contaminated with starch.
📌 考試提醒
在任何涉及物質穿透薄膜的實驗中，必須排除薄膜外初始污染所導致的假陽性結果。
In any experiment involving substances passing through a membrane, false positive results caused by initial external contamination of the membrane must be eliminated.
常見錯誤：忽略了實驗操作過程中的人為污染風險。
Common trap：Ignoring the risk of human contamination during the experimental procedures.

第六題
📌 參考答案
B 碳水化合物、脂肪、蛋白質。
B Carbohydrate, fat, protein.
📌 詳細解釋
當哺乳動物食物供應不足時，碳水化合物（肝糖）會首先被分解成葡萄糖釋放能量。
When a mammal is starving, a carbohydrate (glycogen) will first be broken down into glucose to release energy.
當肝糖用完時，脂肪會被分解；當脂肪亦耗盡，才會分解蛋白質釋放能量。
When glycogen is used up, fats will be broken down; when fats are also consumed, proteins will be broken down to release energy.
📌 考試提醒
三大營養素的消耗順序反映了它們在體內的儲存形式和首要生理功能。
The order of consumption of the three macronutrients reflects their storage forms and primary physiological functions in the body.
常見錯誤：以為脂肪是身體首選的能量來源。
Common trap：Assuming that fat is the body's first choice for an energy source.

第七題
📌 參考答案
D 1、2、3、4和5
D 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5
📌 詳細解釋
氣管(1)內的黏液能阻擋塵和細菌進入身體。
Mucus in the trachea (1) traps dust and germs.
食道(2)和大腸(5)的黏液可以潤滑內壁，使物質較容易通過。
Mucus in the oesophagus (2) and large intestine (5) lubricates the walls so substances can pass easily.
胃(3)和小腸(4)的黏液能保護細胞免被消化液消化。
Mucus in the stomach (3) and small intestine (4) protects cells from being digested by digestive juices.
📌 考試提醒
黏液在不同器官具有不同的功能，包括潤滑、保護及防禦。
Mucus serves different functions in different organs, including lubrication, protection, and defense.
常見錯誤：誤以為大腸只負責吸收水分而沒有黏液分泌。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that the large intestine only absorbs water and lacks mucus secretion.

第八題
📌 參考答案
C 部位4
C Part 4
📌 詳細解釋
小腸(4)是身體中消化和吸收最重要的部份，會吸收營養、鹽分和水分。
The small intestine (4) is the most important site for digestion and absorption, taking in nutrients, salts, and water.
大腸(5)亦會吸收水分，但是沒有小腸吸收的那麼多。
The large intestine (5) also absorbs water, but not as much as the small intestine.
📌 考試提醒
小腸內壁具有大量絨毛，提供了極大的表面積進行吸收作用。
The inner lining of the small intestine has numerous villi, providing a very large surface area for absorption.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為大腸吸收的水分總量最多。
Common trap：Students often mistakenly assume the large intestine absorbs the greatest total volume of water.

第九題
📌 參考答案
A 試管1
A Tube 1
📌 詳細解釋
管X是膽管，所收集的膽汁能將脂肪乳化成細小的油滴。
Duct X is the bile duct, and the collected bile can emulsify fat into smaller droplets.
由於試管1含有花生油（脂肪），因此只有試管1會形成穩定的乳劑。
Since tube 1 contains peanut oil (fat), only tube 1 will form a persistent emulsion.
📌 考試提醒
膽汁不含任何消化酶，乳化作用屬於物理消化，旨在增加脂質與酶接觸的表面積。
Bile does not contain any digestive enzymes; emulsification is a physical digestion process aimed at increasing the surface area for lipid-enzyme contact.
常見錯誤：誤以為膽汁含有能進行化學消化的脂酶。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that bile contains lipase that carries out chemical digestion.

第十題
📌 參考答案
D 它將牙垢染成紅色。
D It dyes the plaque red.
📌 詳細解釋
牙垢膜指示劑的主要用途是將牙垢染成紅色，使我們能看清位置以便清除。
The main purpose of dental disclosing agent is to dye the plaque red so we know where it is and can remove it.
它並不含有氟化物，亦不能殺死細菌。
It does not contain fluoride and cannot kill bacteria.
📌 考試提醒
牙垢膜是由細菌、食物殘渣及唾液形成的黏性薄膜，必須用物理方式（刷牙）清除。
Dental plaque is a sticky film formed by bacteria, food debris, and saliva, which must be removed physically (by brushing).
常見錯誤：誤以為牙垢膜指示劑是一種化學清潔劑或殺菌劑。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that the dental disclosing agent is a chemical cleaner or bactericide.

第十一題
📌 參考答案
C 牠們的成蟲期沒有消化系統。
C Their adult stage has no digestive system.
📌 詳細解釋
絛蟲利用擴散作用直接從寄主身體吸收已消化的食物，因此不需要消化系統。
Tapeworms absorb digested food directly by diffusion and therefore do not possess a digestive system.
絛蟲利用吸盤牢固地吸附在寄主腸壁上，而非用來吸取食物。
Tapeworms use suckers to attach firmly to the host's intestinal wall, not to suck food.
📌 考試提醒
寄生蟲的身體構造往往高度退化（如消化系統），並特化出附著器官以適應寄生生活。
The body structures of parasites are often highly degenerated (like the digestive system), while developing specialized attachment organs to adapt to parasitic life.
常見錯誤：望文生義，誤以為「吸盤」的作用是吸取食物。
Common trap：Taking the term literally and mistakenly believing that "suckers" function to suck food.

第十二題
📌 參考答案
D 胺基酸。
D Amino acids.
📌 詳細解釋
胺基酸是包含氧、碳、氫、氮和其他元素的化合物。
Amino acids are complex molecules containing oxygen, carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, and other elements.
葡萄糖、纖維素和脂肪酸都只含有氧、碳和氫，不含氮。
Glucose, cellulose, and fatty acids are compounds of only oxygen, carbon, and hydrogen, lacking nitrogen.
📌 考試提醒
植物必須從土壤中吸收硝酸鹽等無機氮化物才能合成蛋白質。
Plants must absorb inorganic nitrogenous compounds like nitrates from the soil to synthesize proteins.
常見錯誤：將纖維素的成分與蛋白質混淆，誤以為所有大分子都需要氮。
Common trap：Confusing the composition of cellulose with proteins, mistakenly assuming all macromolecules require nitrogen.

第十三題
📌 參考答案
A 光合作用
A Photosynthesis
📌 詳細解釋
光合作用會吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣。
Photosynthesis takes in carbon dioxide and releases oxygen.
相反地，呼吸作用、燃燒和腐敗作用都會釋放二氧化碳。
Conversely, respiration, burning, and putrefaction all release carbon dioxide.
📌 考試提醒
自然界中的碳循環依賴光合作用作為唯一有效移除大氣二氧化碳的生物過程。
The carbon cycle in nature relies on photosynthesis as the sole effective biological process for removing atmospheric carbon dioxide.
常見錯誤：混淆了植物在不同光照條件下的主要氣體交換方向。
Common trap：Confusing the main direction of gaseous exchange in plants under different light conditions.

第十四題
📌 參考答案
D 開啟、關閉、黃色、紅色
D Open, Closed, Yellow, Red
📌 詳細解釋
要使呼出的空氣吹進指示劑，夾X必須開啟而夾Y必須關閉。
To blow exhaled air into the indicator solution, clip X should be open and clip Y closed.
由於呼出的空氣含較多二氧化碳，會使管1的碳酸氫鹽指示劑由紅色變黃色。
Since exhaled air contains more carbon dioxide, it turns the hydrogencarbonate indicator in tube 1 from red to yellow.
📌 考試提醒
碳酸氫鹽指示劑在二氧化碳濃度升高時變黃，正常空氣中呈紅色，濃度下降時變紫。
Hydrogencarbonate indicator turns yellow when carbon dioxide concentration increases, remains red in normal air, and turns purple when it decreases.
常見錯誤：混淆了呼氣與吸氣時夾子的開關設定，或記錯指示劑的顏色。
Common trap：Confusing the clip settings for exhalation and inhalation, or memorizing the indicator's color incorrectly.

第十五題
📌 參考答案
B 它們是蛋白質。
B They are proteins.
📌 詳細解釋
酶是一種蛋白質，在高溫下會變質並失去催化作用。
Enzymes, which are proteins, are denatured at high temperatures and lose their catalytic properties.
📌 考試提醒
酶的變性是不可逆轉的，高溫會永久破壞酶的活性部位形狀。
The denaturation of enzymes is irreversible; high temperatures permanently destroy the shape of the active site.
常見錯誤：使用「被殺死」來形容酶失去活性，酶是化學分子而非生物。
Common trap：Using "killed" to describe enzymes losing activity; enzymes are chemical molecules, not living organisms.

第十六題
📌 參考答案
C 管R
C Tube R
📌 詳細解釋
試管內的葉片會進行光合作用消耗二氧化碳，令指示劑由紅色變為紫色。
The leaves inside carry out photosynthesis, using up carbon dioxide and turning the indicator from red to purple.
試管R含有最多葉片，消耗二氧化碳最快，因此變色時間最短。
Tube R has the greatest number of leaves, consuming carbon dioxide most rapidly and thus taking the shortest time to change color.
📌 考試提醒
淨氣體交換方向取決於光合作用與呼吸作用的相對速率。
The direction of net gaseous exchange depends on the relative rates of photosynthesis and respiration.
常見錯誤：忽略了光照下植物同時在進行呼吸作用，只考慮單一過程。
Common trap：Ignoring that plants simultaneously carry out respiration under light, considering only a single process.

第十七題
📌 參考答案
D 管S
D Tube S
📌 詳細解釋
在無光環境下植物不能進行光合作用產生氧氣，但呼吸作用仍會消耗氧氣。
In the absence of light, plants cannot photosynthesize to produce oxygen, but respiration still consumes oxygen.
由於試管S沒有綠葉，氧氣不會減少，因此實驗結束時含氧量最多。
Since tube S has no leaves, its oxygen content will not decrease, thus it contains the most oxygen at the end.
📌 考試提醒
植物的呼吸作用是全天候進行的，但光合作用只在有光時發生。
Plant respiration occurs all day round, but photosynthesis only happens in the presence of light.
常見錯誤：誤以為黑暗中植物會釋放氧氣。
Common trap：Assuming plants release oxygen in the dark.

第十八題
📌 參考答案
C 只有(1)和(3)
C Only (1) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
香煙中的焦油會被玻璃棉吸收使其變成棕色。
Tar is trapped by the glass wool, eventually turning it brown.
煙霧中的二氧化碳會使石灰水變成乳白色。
The carbon dioxide produced will turn the limewater milky.
📌 考試提醒
此實驗裝置缺乏特異性化學試劑來測試尼古丁。
This experimental setup lacks a specific chemical reagent to test for nicotine.
常見錯誤：誤以為所有有害物質都能用簡單過濾探測出來。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that all harmful substances can be detected using simple filtration.

第十九題
📌 參考答案
D 只有(2)和(4)
D Only (2) and (4)
📌 詳細解釋
小腦(2)和半規管(4)受損會導致身體失去平衡。
Damage to the cerebellum (2) or semi-circular canals (4) causes problems in balancing.
由於聽覺正常，負責將聲音轉化為神經脈衝的耳蝸(3)仍能正常運作。
Since hearing is normal, the cochlea (3), which converts sound into impulses, is functioning properly.
📌 考試提醒
內耳分為耳蝸（聽覺）及半規管（平衡）。
The inner ear is divided into the cochlea (hearing) and semi-circular canals (balance).
常見錯誤：混淆了大腦(cerebrum)與小腦(cerebellum)的功能。
Common trap：Confusing the functions of the cerebrum and the cerebellum.

第二十題
📌 參考答案
A 氣管
A Trachea
📌 詳細解釋
圖中顯示氣管內壁分泌黏液的細胞及纖毛。
The figure shows mucus-secreting cells and cilia present in the trachea.
黏液用於過濾空氣中的塵埃，而纖毛擺動則將黏液送至咽部。
Mucus is used to trap dust, and cilia waft the mucus up to the pharynx.
📌 考試提醒
小腸內壁有絨毛以增加表面積，氣管內壁則有微小纖毛用作清掃。
The small intestine lining has villi to increase surface area, while the trachea has tiny cilia for sweeping.
常見錯誤：誤以為纖毛的功能是捕捉塵埃，實際上捕捉塵埃的是黏液。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that the function of cilia is to trap dust; in fact, mucus traps dust.

第二十一題
📌 參考答案
B 灰塵微粒的清除
B clearance of dust particles
📌 詳細解釋
內膜上的分泌黏液細胞負責分泌黏液以黏附空氣中的灰塵和細菌。
The mucus-secreting cells on the lining secrete mucus to trap dust and germs in the air.
纖毛的擺動則有助向上推動黏液至咽喉，從而清除灰塵微粒。
The beating of cilia helps to waft the mucus upwards to the pharynx, thereby clearing dust particles.
氣體交換在肺泡發生，而這內膜亦不具備吸收有用物質的功能，因此其餘選項錯誤。
Gas exchange takes place in the alveoli, and this lining does not have the function of absorbing useful substances, thus other options are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
呼吸道的纖毛上皮組織具有防禦功能，屬於非特異性防禦機制。
The ciliated epithelial tissue of the respiratory tract serves a defensive function and is part of the non-specific defense mechanism.
常見錯誤：誤以為纖毛負責進行氣體交換或直接過濾灰塵。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that cilia are responsible for gas exchange or directly filtering dust.

第二十二題
📌 參考答案
C 子變形蟲含有的染色體數目是親體的一半
C the daughter amoebae have half the number of chromosomes as the parent
📌 詳細解釋
變形蟲的二分體分裂屬於有絲分裂，子細胞的染色體數目與母細胞完全相同。
Binary fission in Amoeba is a type of mitosis, meaning the number of chromosomes in the daughter cells is exactly the same as in the parent cell.
每次分裂會產生兩隻基因相同的子變形蟲，而新生子變形蟲的體積較親體小。
Each division produces two genetically identical daughter amoebae, and the newly formed ones are smaller than the parent.
📌 考試提醒
無性繁殖依賴有絲分裂，以保持物種遺傳物質的穩定性。
Asexual reproduction relies on mitosis to maintain the stability of the species' genetic material.
常見錯誤：混淆了二分體分裂（有絲分裂）與產生配子的減數分裂。
Common trap：Confusing binary fission (mitosis) with meiosis, which produces gametes.

第二十三題
📌 參考答案
B 滲透、蒸發、擴散
B osmosis, evaporation, diffusion
📌 詳細解釋
程序(i)中，泥土中的水分子透過滲透作用進入根毛細胞。
In process (i), water molecules from the soil enter the root hair cells by osmosis.
程序(ii)中，水分子從葉肉細胞表面蒸發成為水蒸氣。
In process (ii), water molecules evaporate from the surface of mesophyll cells to form water vapour.
程序(iii)中，氣室內的水蒸氣透過擴散作用經氣孔離開葉片。
In process (iii), water vapour in the air space leaves the leaf through the stomata by diffusion.
📌 考試提醒
蒸騰作用涉及葉片內水分蒸發及水蒸氣擴散出氣孔兩個物理過程。
Transpiration involves two physical processes: the evaporation of water inside the leaf and the diffusion of water vapour out of the stomata.
常見錯誤：將水分子離開葉肉細胞的過程（蒸發）與水蒸氣離開氣孔的過程（擴散）混為一談。
Common trap：Confusing the process of water leaving mesophyll cells (evaporation) with water vapour leaving the stomata (diffusion).

第二十四題
